integrity: A full analytic proof, an exact polynomial factorization, and a standalone symbolic/numerical checker are supplied. Independent audit and independent validation have not been performed.
limitations: The claim is specific to the quadratic taper and its first cosine modulation on SO(3); no classification is asserted on other groups or for higher-frequency modulation. The geometric and spectral claims have only self-review, and equivalent unindexed derivations remain possible.
title: Sharp signed-cosine taper threshold on \(SO(3)\) and a Euclidean positivity separation
